title: A Fast-Convergence Resolution of the Stochastic Eigenproblem Using Halley's Method and the Spectral-Chaos Approach
summary: Solving stochastic eigenvalue problems has long been essential for informed decision-making, advancing scientific knowledge, and ensuring the reliability of engineering designs and applications. This paper underscores the need to continue enhancing existing numerical methods for solving the stochastic eigenproblem in order to improve convergence rates, computational efficiency, and robustness.
